questions.q: The left rear carries forward. Tap where the right rear player should support.
options: Up the right side, level with the front
questions.explain: Yes. Inside and behind the ball, the rear player gives a safe pass and protects behind.
choiceExplanations: That is up with the front pair, so nobody protects behind if we lose the ball.

questions.q: The rear players take turns to carry. Put the steps in order.
options: Right rear tucks inside, behind the ball
Pass across, now the right rear carries
Left rear tucks inside as support
questions.explain: Yes. The left rear carries first, and the right rear tucks in behind to support.
choiceExplanations: Yes. The left rear carries first, and the right rear tucks in behind to support.
The support move comes after the carry, so the teammate can stay behind the ball.
The pass across comes after the first carry, and then the right rear carries.
This comes last: now the right rear carries, so the left rear becomes the support.

questions.q: Now the right rear carries inside. Drag the left rear player to the best support space.
options: Up the wing, level with the ball
questions.explain: Yes. Inside and behind the ball gives a safe pass back and protects our goal.
choiceExplanations: That corner is far from the ball, so the pass back is long and easy to cut out.
